recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes FHIR-32512 for the current build-scoped ModelInfo example; any broader stale Procedure ModelInfo cleanup should be handled by separate Jira-specific reconciliation rather than expanding this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-32512 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification. It asked to clarify how a detailed follow-up CarePlan can link back to Procedure; the accepted resolution changed CarePlan.addresses to allow Procedure and MedicationAdministration references, changed Procedure.followUp to CodeableReference<ServiceRequest | PlanDefinition>, and added Procedure.followUp prose stating that CarePlan can reference Procedure via CarePlan.addresses.

The active FHIR ModelInfo example was not updated in that historical application.
additional_context: Procedure, CarePlan, and Library are active in source/fhir.ini. The Library examples page links source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml as the FHIR model information file used by the CQL-to-ELM translator, and the file is labeled modelInfo version 6.0.0. Confluence references show Patient Care pages mentioning FHIR-32512, and direct Zulip issue-key search found no conflicting discussion.
